# HttpMethod

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - enum.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Use qualified values rather than raw integers. These are open nominal enums: each enum has its own type, and its known values are listed below. Host operations may reject unknown or unsupported values even though the enum can store them. See [enum rules and bit operations](../../../new_ppl.md#enum--endenum-declaration-350).

The default value is `HttpMethod.Get` (the first declared member).

## Values

| Name | Integer value | Meaning |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `HttpMethod.Get` | `0` | HTTP request method accepted by the policy-controlled request builder: GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, or PATCH. GET and HEAD cannot carry a body. |
| `HttpMethod.Head` | `1` | HTTP request method accepted by the policy-controlled request builder: GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, or PATCH. GET and HEAD cannot carry a body. |
| `HttpMethod.Post` | `2` | HTTP request method accepted by the policy-controlled request builder: GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, or PATCH. GET and HEAD cannot carry a body. |
| `HttpMethod.Put` | `3` | HTTP request method accepted by the policy-controlled request builder: GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, or PATCH. GET and HEAD cannot carry a body. |
| `HttpMethod.Delete` | `4` | HTTP request method accepted by the policy-controlled request builder: GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, or PATCH. GET and HEAD cannot carry a body. |
| `HttpMethod.Patch` | `5` | HTTP request method accepted by the policy-controlled request builder: GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, or PATCH. GET and HEAD cannot carry a body. |

## Has

```PPL
HttpMethod.Has(HttpMethod mask) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Returns BOOLEAN: true if all bits in the mask are set. Receiver and mask must have the same enum type and are evaluated once, receiver first. No intermediate enum value is constructed. A zero mask always returns true; use equality with the zero member to test that no bits are set. Available from language 350; requires runtime 400.
